selection_method: Choose one task per distinct primary decoding challenge with distinct report IDs; include E tasks separately subject to user decision on E01/E02 shared report.
repetitiveness: 24 decoding tasks use unique reports but several test similar skills on nearby observations; 9 selected to reduce conceptual overlap. E01/E02 reuse one METAR and are reported separately. Independent report IDs do not imply statistical independence.
uncertainty: Sample is too small and non-random to claim general accuracy. The historical exploratory context means it is not a fully blinded holdout.
